annotations.title: Polish income tax on a salary earned abroad: treaty method, NBP rates, abolition relief

description: Use for the Polish income tax of a Polish resident on a salary earned abroad (PIT z zagranicy, praca za granicą, ulga abolicyjna, PIT/ZG): treaty method after the MLI, NBP conversion, 30% per diem, surcharge or refund in Poland. For withholding tax on payments to foreign companies use get_tax_treaty. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Calculate the Polish income tax of a Polish tax resident on a salary from an employment contract abroad (PIT z zagranicy) in Germany, Netherlands, United Kingdom, Norway, Ireland, Belgium, Denmark, Austria, Spain, France, Czechia, Sweden, Italy or the United States. Gives the treaty method for the tax year after the MLI convention (exemption with progression: no tax on the foreign income, it only raises the rate on Polish income; proportional credit: the foreign income is taxed in Poland with a credit for the foreign tax and the abolition relief up to its cap), each monthly payment converted at the NBP average rate of the last business day before the payment, the 30% per diem exemption for each day abroad, employee costs, the tax due in Poland, the surcharge or refund against Polish advances, the extra tax caused by the foreign income, whether a PIT-36 return with PIT/ZG and PIT/O is needed and the filing deadline. Not for business income, pensions or non-residents.

days_abroad.description: Days of stay abroad while employed, weekends and leave included. Default the calendar days of the period.

foreign_tax_fx.description: Income tax paid abroad in the same currency. Default 0.

gross_fx.description: Gross salary for the period of work abroad in the currency of that country (EUR, GBP, NOK, DKK, SEK, CZK or USD).

months.description: Months of work abroad in the tax year. Default 12.

offshore.description: Work outside land territory (at sea): abolition relief without the cap.

pay_day.description: Pay day in the month. Default last.

pl_advances.description: Income tax advances withheld in Poland, PLN. Default 0.

pl_income.description: Income from Poland on the tax scale after social contributions, PLN. Default 0.

start_month.description: First month of work abroad. Default 1.

year.description: Tax year. Default the year of the coming or current PIT season.
